dict.string: MinuteMind records your microphone so it can capture your side of the conversation.
MinuteMind needs speech recognition to transcribe your calls.
MinuteMind captures system audio via screen recording APIs without disturbing your setup.
MinuteMind can sync your tasks with Apple Reminders to send you notifications on all your devices.
MinuteMind can add time blockers to your calendar to help you schedule focused work time for your tasks.
